about: Classes 3.0 step 1b: one row of each system spec's 'Built from' table written in data on the step 1a and 1b primitives (test only: not game content; the systems' own ids, numbers and resources come with their steps). test/prim-specs-1b.test.ts proves each is well formed, run by the generic runners, and does what its row says.

relics.spec: bonds-spec.md 6.1, the echo (13): a heal you give comes back as damage to every enemy Bonded to you at its next turn
relics.name: Echo (spec row)
relics.text: When you heal, every enemy tied to you takes a share of it at the start of its next turn.

relics.spec: figments-spec.md 6.1, Volatile: its fall bursts on everyone next to it
relics.name: Volatile (spec row)
relics.text: When this unit goes down, everyone within 1 tile takes damage.

relics.spec: shadow-spec.md 6 and 10, the Break as a data toggle (rev4-primitives.md section 2: one term from the meter, the ambush and Mark)
relics.name: The Break (spec row)
relics.text: A toggle on an attack while Hidden: the hit is multiplied by 1 + a share of the ambush and of a Mark.

relics.spec: reactions-spec.md 6, Run and Gun: a hit with a shot adds a point of Pressure to its target
relics.name: Run and Gun (spec row)
relics.text: Your shot's hit adds 1 Pressure to its target.

relics.spec: heal-shield-percent-spec.md 4: a heal gated at a share of its target's max HP
relics.name: Gated Mend (spec row)
relics.text: At your turn start you heal yourself, at least a fifth of your max HP (counted up to 145).

verbs.spec: chaplain-spec.md 6, Ward: a Whisper (prayer) at an ally in sight, a shield on its own layer, at most two carry yours
verbs.name: Ward (spec row)
verbs.text: A Whisper: an ally you see within 6 tiles, or you, gains a ward on its own layer; at most two carry yours.

verbs.spec: figments-spec.md 6.1, Picture: a verb that makes an owned unit (spawn)
verbs.name: Picture (spec row)
verbs.text: Make a drone next to you.
